heroTitle: I design and build AI products that turn complex work into clear, verifiable outcomes.
heroBody: Relay completes employee-service workflows from grounded answer to confirmed action. Refract keeps papers, citations, comparisons, datasets, and model results connected inside one research session. Homeward converts discharge records into source-linked recovery tasks. Birb Hangout gives distant friends a shared 3D room for music, video, reading, games, rest, and flight. The medical-imaging studies add peer-reviewed atrophy measurement and a four-class CNN ensemble result.

modules.title: What the portfolio demonstrates
modules.markdown: The product dossiers explain the interface, system architecture, implemented workflow, evaluation method, and resulting improvement behind each build. The ML studies document two distinct achievements: a peer-reviewed OpenCV method for measuring brain atrophy and a four-class TensorFlow experiment that improved held-out accuracy through probability-level ensembling.
